description: Whether refinancing is worth it: the new payment, monthly saving, and how many months it takes to recover closing costs. Also compares lifetime interest, which catches the common trap where a lower payment costs more overall because the term was reset.

inputSchema.description: Refinance break-even in months, plus the effect on lifetime interest.

closingCosts.description: Total cost to close the refinance, in US dollars.

currentAnnualRatePercent.description: Interest rate on the existing loan.

currentBalance.description: Remaining principal on the existing loan.

currentRemainingTermMonths.description: Months still to run on the existing loan.

financeClosingCosts.description: Roll closing costs into the new balance instead of paying cash.

newTermYears.description: Loan term in years. Most US mortgages are 15 or 30.

name: calculate_refinance

outputSchema.description: Monthly saving, break-even and lifetime cost of refinancing a loan.

breakEvenMonths.description: Months to recover closing costs; null if never.

currentMonthlyPayment.description: Current monthly principal and interest, in dollars.

disclaimer.description: Estimate-only notice that should accompany any figure shown to a person.

lifetimeInterestDifference.description: Interest on the new loan minus interest left on the current one.

lowersLifetimeCost.description: Whether refinancing lowers total cost over the life of the loan.

monthlySavings.description: Monthly difference; negative when the payment rises.

newLoanAmount.description: New loan amount including financed costs, in dollars.

newMonthlyPayment.description: New monthly principal and interest, in dollars.

remainingInterestIfYouKeepCurrentLoan.description: Interest left on the current loan, in dollars.

totalInterestOnNewLoan.description: Interest over the new loan, in dollars.

worthwhile.description: Whether the break-even and lifetime cost both favour refinancing.

title: Evaluate a refinance
